definitions.definition: a tubular organ in an aquatic animal (especially in mollusks) through which water can be taken in or expelled
a tube running from the liquid in a vessel to a lower level outside the vessel so that atmospheric pressure forces the liquid through the tube
convey, draw off, or empty by or as if by a siphon
of or relating to or infected with syphilis
a common venereal disease caused by the treponema pallidum spirochete
